name: Relay

Organization membership, operator/reviewer roles, invitations and credential lifecycle
Immutable shared schema v1/v2 fingerprints and reviewed bounded transformations

Corrections, stale-version protection and file/mapping/contract/destination-bound approval
Atomic local effects, row ledger and checkpoint with before/after commit crash recovery

invariants.claim: Local destination effects, row outcomes and checkpoint commit together; crash before commit rolls back, crash after commit resumes past the durable prefix
Membership scopes jobs/rows/reports/proposals; reviewer gates approval, diagnostics, retry and invitations
New approval format binds file hash, mapping/correction/transform version, immutable schema fingerprint and destination; legacy approval remains supported
Durable outbox precedes network writes; stable receipt keys reconcile response loss without repeating effects under the test API contract
Imports insert missing identities and classify conflicting data; existing contacts are never overwritten
Pinned local model sees headers only and returns an unapplied proposal; mapping validation and reviewer approval remain explicit

passed: 100k real after-commit crash with two-worker recovery
Complete Chromium workflow with AI proposals and operational views
Real pg_dump/pg_restore and original hash verification
Final standalone production artifact and complete Chromium workflow
Fresh migrations and non-demo administrator bootstrap

learning.completion: Not assessed; learner attempts and independent explanations have not been observed

limitations: Public hosting target not supplied; private GitHub repository created
Docker definitions authored; Docker unavailable locally
Independent review/human handover and learner mastery not observed
External integration is a controlled test API with strong receipts, not an arbitrary CRM
English-header AI benchmark is small; similarity is not calibrated confidence
Parser restart rescans a logical-record prefix; opening a workbook may scan the archive
Source storage is one shared durable volume, not cross-host object storage
API-enforced tenant isolation; no PostgreSQL RLS claim
Malformed input reports only its staged prefix; unstaged source records are not falsely counted
External requests already authorized for sending may complete after pause/cancel
